sentiment.rationale: The company delivered a strong Q1 with revenue of $1,008 million (up 18% Y/Y), which was above the high end of its guidance range, and Q2 revenue guidance of $1,133-$1,153 million (14-16% growth) is roughly consistent with Q1 on a constant currency basis, indicating a stable forward outlook rather than a material raise. Management expressed confidence in its long-term targets and highlighted strong AI-driven momentum, but also noted that progress may not be linear and that international growth will moderate in Q2 due to deliberate organizational changes. The forward guidance was held roughly in line with the prior trajectory, and the beat was partially attributed to a one-time reversal from Canada digital services tax, so the score is mildly positive but not a strong buy signal.

summary.revenue: $1,008 million, up 18% year-over-year (15% on a constant currency basis).
summary.eps: GAAP net loss per share of $0.12 (basic and diluted); Non-GAAP net income per share of $0.27.
summary.guidance: Q2 2026 revenue expected in the range of $1,133 million to $1,153 million, representing 14%-16% growth year-over-year. Q2 2026 Adjusted EBITDA expected in the range of $256 million to $276 million. Full year 2026 Adjusted EBITDA margin expected to be around 29%.
summary.margin: Adjusted EBITDA margin of 20% in Q1 2026, up 40 basis points year-over-year. Full year 2026 Adjusted EBITDA margin expected to be around 29%.
key_risks: Continued headwind from largest retail advertisers, though partially offset by AI-driven improvements.
Moderation of international growth in Q2 due to deliberate leadership and structural changes in the international go-to-market organization.
Lapping more difficult comparisons in Rest of World and Europe in Q2 due to ramping of resellers and elevated cross-border spend following US tariffs.
Impact from the conflict in the Middle East, seen most directly in Rest of World and to a lesser extent in Europe, isolated to certain verticals impacted by higher oil prices.
General economic uncertainty, inflation, tariffs, and foreign exchange fluctuations as stated in forward-looking statements.
key_opportunities: AI-driven ad platform improvements, including Pinterest Performance+ campaigns, which are growing lower funnel spend for adopters at nearly twice the rate of non-adopters.
Expansion of go-to-market organization to broaden revenue base across mid-market, enterprise, managed SMB, and international advertisers.
Strengthening measurement and attribution capabilities to capture more of the value Pinterest drives for advertisers.
tvScientific acquisition to extend Pinterest's audiences and signals to power performance Connected TV campaigns.
Continued user growth and deepening engagement, with 631 million global MAUs and 80 billion+ monthly searches.

management_tone.label: optimistic
management_tone.justification: Management described a 'strong start to 2026' and expressed confidence in the long-term opportunity, while acknowledging that 'progress may not always be linear'.
